about: Rise of Shadows' interface (docs/packs/format.md, 'UI theme'): the floating city of Dalaran at night during the League of E.V.I.L.'s heist — dark panels of midnight-blue Violet Citadel stone with gilded rims, buttons of deep arcane violet that flare gold under the mouse like a stolen coin, pale moonlit text on the parchment of a heist plan, gold for headings, poison green for confirmations and a villain's crimson for danger, arcane sparks rising over the menu; the title in Classic's Alegreya SC, in gold.
